scientific_integrity: Commutation reduction proved symbolically for all finite height-two posets and prime-power fields; separate finite-algorithm verification is not a substitute for the all-graph proof. Publication priority remains provisional.
scientific_limitations: Only finite height-two posets and finite fields; no longer-chain or multiple-arrow formula is claimed. The asymptotic fixes the comparability graph as field order grows. The Fortuin–Kasteleyn expansion and matroid-union rank identity are classical; an unidentified broader result on square-zero extensions could subsume the exact commuting-pair formula.
title: Commutation of height-two incidence algebras is a Potts partition function with a two-forest exponent
